trigger_conditions: Rolling skew/kurt numerical stability issue: a “polluted window in rolling kurt” leading to incorrect computation; on numerical instability the window should be recomputed from scratch with central moments computed online.
Numeric discrepancy discussed for value range (-1000, 1000) where rolling algorithm should keep the old (historical) value stable with new values.
“Similar to #62863”: on numerical instability “window is recomputed from scratch … and computes the central moments online.”

input_output_examples.input: Rolling skew/kurt large value range test (test_rolling_skew_kurt_large_value_range): window=4; input data includes values from the set [1e6, -1e6, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].
input_output_examples.expected_output: np.nan repeated 3 times followed by [1.5, 4.0, -1.2, -1.2, -1.2] (i.e., [np.nan, np.nan, np.nan, 1.5, 4.0, -1.2, -1.2, -1.2]).
input_output_examples.source: passage: “In test_rolling_skew_kurt_large_value_range(method): ... window=4 ... checks exact expected outputs [np.nan]*3 + [1.5, 4.0, -1.2, -1.2, -1.2].”

oracle_clues: “BUG: fix polluted window in rolling kurt” (PR#63143) and “fix(roll_kurt): use online update with instability check”.
On numerical instability: “window is recomputed from scratch … computes the central moments online.”
Test for numerical stability for kurt and skew was added.
Discussion for GH#54380 references loss of precision concerns and expects rolling algorithm behavior to keep historical value stable; issue discussion mentions value range (-1000, 1000).
Code-level clue: “record num of same values to remove floating point artifacts” and the online update logic updates kurt moments (m4/m3/m2/mean).

category_specific_evidence: In test_rolling_skew_kurt_large_value_range(method): rolling skew/kurt numerical stability uses input data ranges including [1e6, -1e6, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6] with window=4, and checks exact expected outputs [np.nan]*3 + [1.5, 4.0, -1.2, -1.2, -1.2].

In test_same_result_with_different_lengths(method) (GH-54380): rolling window_size=8 compares results for method in ["skew","kurt"] between Series(data[:10]).rolling(8) and Series(data).rolling(8), where data is generated by rng.normal(loc=0.0, scale=1e3, size=len_bigger) with len_smaller=10 and len_bigger=12.

Discussion text for GH-54380 explicitly references potential loss of precision as a possibility (“Are you sure that this is not caused by a loss of precision? Your values are quite large for these algorithms”).
In issue#54380: the values are discussed as “(-1000, 1000)” and whether that is “not very large value,” in the context of rolling algorithm stability.
Code comment in pandas/_libs/window/aggregations.pyx: “GH#42064, record num of same values to remove floating point artifacts” (suggests floating-point artifact sensitivity).
Code snippet shows online update logic for kurt-related accumulators (m4/m3/m2/mean) being updated incrementally (mean[0] += delta_n; m2[0] += term1; m3[0] += ...; m4[0] = new_m4).
